representativeSnapshot.kind: fresh local Supabase schema plus existing event_attendance rows

rowCountQueries: Count public.event_attendance rows and confirm event_id/user_id uniqueness
Confirm existing event_attendance rows reference legacy public.events records
Confirm no existing event_table column or polymorphic attendance unique key
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Existing attendance rows receive event_table = events; no attendance rows are deleted or rewritten

execution.resumeStrategy: Add the compatibility column with a deterministic legacy default, replace only the legacy uniqueness key, and create the validated polymorphic check and index
execution.idempotency: Column, named constraint, check, and index are guarded or deterministically replaced; reruns preserve attendance rows

quarantine.strategy: Existing attendance rows use the legacy events table by definition; unexpected event_table values are rejected by the validated check

constraints: event_attendance_event_table_check is created NOT VALID then validated
legacy unique(event_id, user_id) is replaced with unique(event_id, user_id, event_table)
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify legacy attendance reads, events_v2 upsert compatibility, unrelated-user denial, and the complete migration chain

recovery.rollback: Use a reviewed forward migration; do not remove event_table or collapse attendance records
recovery.forwardFix: Resolve any unexpected event-table values, validate the named check, and rerun the unified guest-list migration

queries: Verify event_table is non-null and constrained to artist_events, events, or events_v2
Verify the polymorphic unique key and event-table index
Verify the unified guest-list migration can create its event_attendance constraint and functions
